lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters are distributed posterior to the branchial slits. These form a non-uniform grid, with a cluster of three distinct maxima positioned dorsally above the third and fourth gill slits, and a vertical column of maxima following the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity are visible in the mid-flank region, aligned with the vertical axes of the branchial slits and intersecting with the high-luminance blobs to create a lattice-like arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light-reflecting upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.
